mapper.insert: INSERT INTO md_content_report ( target_type, target_id, reason_code, detail, target_snapshot, reporter_user_id, reporter_anon_id, status ) VALUES ( #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reasonCode}, #{detail}, #{targetSnapshot}, #{reporterUserId}, #{reporterAnonId}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM md_content_report WHERE status = 'PENDING'
SELECT no, target_type, target_id, reason_code, detail, target_snapshot, reporter_user_id, status, handled_by, handled_at, created_at FROM md_content_report WHERE no = #{no}
